entities.summary: Benjamin Joseph Steele is an American professional football coach and former tight end who is the tight ends coach for the Washington Commanders of the National Football League (NFL). Steele played college football for the Fort Lewis Skyhawks and Mesa State and played professionally for several NFL teams.
